title: Outgrowing the Curse of Multilinguality: Scaling Strategies for Efficient Language Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2512.10772v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Training high-performing language models which include medium- and lower-resource languages remains a challenge. Massively multilingual models still underperform language-specific adaptations, especially at smaller scales, due to the curse of multilinguality. In this work, we investigate scaling as an efficient strategy for adapting pretrained models to new target languages. Through comprehensive ablations matched for data and training FLOPs, we test whether upscaling from English base models enables more effective and resource-efficient adaptation than standard continued pretraining. We find that upscaling is an efficient strategy for improving target-language performance by relieving capacity constraints, especially for higher-resourced languages. translated_title: 摆脱多语言诅咒：面向高效语言适配的规模扩展策略
translated_abstract: 训练包含中等及低资源语言的高性能语言模型仍然是一项挑战。受“多语言诅咒”影响，大规模多语言模型的表现仍不及针对特定语言的适配模型，尤其是在较小规模下。在这项工作中，我们研究了规模扩展作为将预训练模型适配到新目标语言的高效策略。通过在数据和训练FLOPs上严格对齐的全面消融实验，我们检验了从英语基础模型向上扩展是否比标准的继续预训练能实现更有效且更节省资源的适配。我们发现，向上扩展是一种通过缓解容量约束来提升目标语言性能的高效策略，对资源较丰富的语言尤其有效。对于低资源语言，先在英语上进行一步向上扩展是有益的；然而，在资源较丰富的场景中，直接在目标语言上进行扩展在计算上更为高效。
tldr: 该论文发现通过向上扩展缓解模型容量约束是高效的语言适配策略：对低资源语言宜先在英语上扩展，而对高资源语言直接在目标语言上扩展更为节省算力。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that upscaling pretrained models to relieve capacity constraints is an efficient language adaptation strategy, where an initial English upscaling step benefits low-resource languages while directly scaling up on the target language is more compute-efficient for high-resource languages.
